results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (13-29 Oct)
reasoning: Management said ₹3,021 Cr of the ₹35,274 Cr order book is scheduled for execution in Q3. Spot business is now 'a negligible share'. In Q2 scheduled execution was ₹2,228 Cr and revenue came in at ₹2,529 Cr (about 13% higher), so Q3 revenue of about ₹3,150 Cr is the base case.
Operational EBITDA margin was 27.1% in Q2 and the MD wants to 'perform or better' from Q3 (the FY29 target is now about 30%). We use 27.5%.
Net finance cost should fall from Q3 after the Q2 loan prepayments; Q2 also carried a ₹49 Cr impairment that should not recur.
risks: Capacity and raw-material (germanium, helium) limits cap volume
Further US tariff refund is small and uncertain
caveat: Q2 operating profit on Screener (₹812 Cr) and PAT (₹517 Cr) include a one-time ₹161 Cr US tariff refund. Underlying Q2 operating profit was about ₹685 Cr and PAT about ₹430 Cr, which is the right base for comparison.
